introduction: A finished turn can now play a sound of its own, from 33 sounds in five groups, each with a preview.

cards.title: 33 completion sounds
cards.summary: Choose what a finished turn plays, in Settings, Notifications & Sound: fanfares, Level Up, Coin and Power-Up, quiet chimes, futuristic tones and playful ones, in five groups.
details: Every sound has a play button, so you can hear it before you choose it. Clicking a sound chooses it.
The new sounds are original, made by Claude Overhead itself, short, and matched in loudness.

image.alt: The Completion sound section: Same as the alert sound, then Victory & Achievement and Retro & Gaming, each sound with a play button.

cards.title: Your sounds stay as they were
cards.summary: Until you choose a completion sound, a finished turn plays the alert sound, exactly as before. Requests, questions and failures keep the alert sound.
details: The five existing sounds are all in the new collection.
The volume, the per-session bells and the completion glow work as before. Turning on a session's bell plays your completion sound.
